mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no as orderNo, product_name as productName, planned_qty as plannedQty, status, planned_start_date as plannedStartDate FROM mis_production_order WHERE status = '1' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY planned_start_date ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT status, CASE status WHEN '0' THEN '草稿' WHEN '1' THEN '已下达' WHEN '2' THEN '部分完成' WHEN '3' THEN '已完成' ELSE status END as statusText, COUNT(*) as count FROM mis_production_order WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(planned_qty), 0) FROM mis_production_plan WHERE DATE_FORMAT(planned_start_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND plan_status IN ('1', '2') AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_qty), 0) FROM mis_production_batch WHERE DATE_FORMAT(production_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_production_batch WHERE status = 'PRODUCING' AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_production_batch WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'WEIGHING') AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_production_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pb.actual_qty), 0) FROM mis_production_task pt LEFT JOIN mis_production_batch pb ON pt.batch_id = pb.id WHERE pt.actual_operator_id = #{operatorId} AND pt.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pt.del_flag = '0' AND pb.del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(pt.actual_end_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_production_task WHERE assigned_operator_id = #{operatorId} AND status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mis_production_task WHERE actual_operator_id = #{operatorId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(actual_end_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')

SELECT pb.id, pb.batch_no as batchNo, p.product_name as productName, pb.product_code as productCode, pb.planned_qty as plannedQty, pb.production_date as productionDate, po.order_no as orderNo FROM mis_production_batch pb LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON pb.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN mis_production_order po ON pb.order_id = po.id WHERE pb.status = 'PENDING' AND pb.production_date = CURDATE() AND pb.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pb.production_date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT pb.id, pb.batch_no as batchNo, p.product_name as productName, pb.product_code as productCode, pb.planned_qty as plannedQty, pb.actual_qty as actualQty, pb.status, pb.weighing_start_time as weighingStartTime, po.order_no as orderNo, CASE WHEN pb.planned_qty > 0 THEN ROUND(pb.actual_qty / pb.planned_qty * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END as progress FROM mis_production_batch pb LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON pb.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN mis_production_order po ON pb.order_id = po.id WHERE pb.status IN ('WEIGHING', 'WEIGHED', 'PRODUCING') AND pb.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pb.weighing_start_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT pb.id, pb.batch_no as batchNo, p.product_name as productName, pb.product_code as productCode, pb.planned_qty as plannedQty, pb.production_date as productionDate, r.routing_name as routingName, po.order_no as orderNo FROM mis_production_batch pb LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON pb.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN mis_production_order po ON pb.order_id = po.id LEFT JOIN mis_process_routing r ON pb.recipe_id = r.id WHERE pb.status = 'PENDING' AND pb.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pb.production_date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT pt.id, pt.task_no as taskNo, pb.batch_no as batchNo, p.product_name as productName, pt.product_code as productCode, prs.step_name as stepName, prs.step_desc as stepDesc, pt.plan_duration as planDuration, e.equipment_name as equipmentName, pt.sequence FROM mis_production_task pt LEFT JOIN mis_production_batch pb ON pt.batch_id = pb.id LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON pt.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN mis_process_routing_step prs ON pt.routing_detail_id = prs.id LEFT JOIN mis_equipment e ON pt.plan_equipment_id = e.id WHERE pt.status = 'PENDING' AND pt.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pt.create_time ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT pt.id, pt.task_no as taskNo, pb.batch_no as batchNo, p.product_name as productName, pt.product_code as productCode, pt.product_color as productColor, prs.step_name as stepName, prs.step_desc as stepDesc, pt.status, pt.plan_duration as planDuration, e.equipment_name as equipmentName, pt.sequence, pt.create_time as createTime FROM mis_production_task pt LEFT JOIN mis_production_batch pb ON pt.batch_id = pb.id LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON pt.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN mis_process_routing_step prs ON pt.routing_detail_id = prs.id LEFT JOIN mis_equipment e ON pt.plan_equipment_id = e.id WHERE pt.assigned_operator_id = #{operatorId} AND pt.status IN ('ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') AND pt.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY pt.create_time ASC

SELECT s.id, m.material_code as materialCode, m.material_name as materialName, s.goods_spec as goodsSpec, s.quantity as currentQty, s.safety_stock_qty as safetyStockQty, (s.safety_stock_qty - s.quantity) as shortageQty FROM mis_stock s LEFT JOIN mis_material m ON s.goods_id = m.id WHERE s.goods_type = 'RAW' AND s.quantity < s.safety_stock_qty AND s.safety_stock_qty > 0 AND s.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY shortageQty DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT id, equipment_code as equipmentCode, equipment_name as equipmentName, equipment_type as equipmentType, status, location FROM mis_equipment WHERE status != '0' ORDER BY status DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(production_date, '%m-%d') as day, COALESCE(SUM(actual_qty), 0) as actualQty, COUNT(*) as batchCount FROM mis_production_batch WHERE production_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(production_date, '%m-%d') ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT p.product_name as productName, COALESCE(SUM(pb.actual_qty), 0) as actualQty FROM mis_production_batch pb LEFT JOIN mis_product p ON pb.product_id = p.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(pb.production_date, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') AND pb.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pb.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY pb.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY actualQty DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as taskCount FROM mis_production_task WHERE del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY status ORDER BY taskCount DESC
